name: Perk
description:
Run spend reports, see trip itineraries, check event attendance, and retrieve invoices all from your AI assistant. Perk MCP connects your travel, spend, invoices and events from Perk with the AI tools you use every day.

You sign in with your own Perk account, so you only ever see data you already have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.perk.com/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perk provides these MCP tools: expenses_query_expenses, identity_search_users, reports_create_travel_report, reports_get_travel_report, trips_get, and trips_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Perk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Perk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Perk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Perk is developed by Perk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
